papers.title: Post-processing strategies for generative design outcomes in a UAV tail boom
papers.abstract: Abstract Generative design produces structurally efficient but organically shaped geometries that require post-processing before Fused Deposition Modeling (FDM) manufacturing. This paper compares two post-processing strategies applied to the same generative design outcome for an Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) tail boom: a complex variant faithful to the raw topology, and a simplified variant with symmetric arms, self-supporting geometry, and uniform cross-sections oriented toward FDM manufacturability. Both variants were evaluated using linear static and buckling finite element analysis underidentical loading conditions. Scaled prototypes of the simplified variant were FDM-printed at two infill configurations and physically load-tested. The manufacturing-oriented simplification reduced both mass and print time while eliminating support structures; peak stress remained well below the material limit. FEA-predicted stress concentrations correlated with observed fracture locations in physical tests. For lightly loaded polymer FDM structures, these results suggest that manufacturing-oriented simplification of generative design outcomes incurs a negligible structural penalty while improving printability and reducing production cost.
papers.venue: The International Journal of Advanced Manufacturing Technology

llm.relevance_to_user: 该文讨论生成式设计与FDM后处理，与生物打印AI工作流无直接关系，仅可作为增材制造后处理思路的背景参考。
llm.why_not_core: This paper addresses generative design post-processing and FDM manufacturability for a UAV part, with no AI/ML integration, no bioprinting workflow stage, and no biological or biomedical validation.

summary_zh.motivation: 生成式设计几何复杂，需后处理才能用于FDM制造。
summary_zh.method: 对比原始复杂构型与面向FDM简化的对称自支撑构型，做静力与屈曲有限元分析并打印缩比件加载测试。
summary_zh.result: 简化构型减重、缩短打印时间且免支撑，峰值应力远低于材料极限，FEA应力集中与断裂位置吻合。
summary_zh.validation: FDM缩比样件物理加载试验与有限元结果对照。

summary_en.motivation: Generative design yields structurally efficient but organically shaped geometries that are difficult to fabricate directly by FDM.
summary_en.method: Two post-processing variants of the same UAV tail-boom generative design were compared using linear static and buckling FEA, and scaled simplified prototypes were FDM-printed at two infill levels and load-tested.
summary_en.result: Manufacturing-oriented simplification reduced mass and print time while removing supports, with peak stresses remaining far below the material limit and FEA stress concentrations matching observed fracture locations.
summary_en.validation: Physical load testing of FDM-printed scaled prototypes was compared against finite element predictions.

papers.title: Safe and Interpretable Vehicle Platoon Control via Physics-Enhanced Residual Learning
papers.abstract: Abstract Vehicle platoon control in complex dynamic environments necessitates a rigorous balance between physical interpretability safety constraints and nonlinear compensation. This paper presents PERL, a Physics-Enhanced Residual Learning framework that hierarchically integrates Distributed Model Predictive Control (DMPC) with Twin Delayed Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (TD3) algorithm. To address the pathological residual action saturation. we propose a residual-magnitude-based action regularization mechanism. This mechanism penalizes large-amplitude residuals to stabilize the policy update and constrain the RL module within a safe, small-amplitude regime, ensuring effective compensation for unmodeled dynamics beyond the physical baseline’s fidelity. Additionally, a spatiotemporal smooth handover and dynamic fusion strategy significantly enhances edge-case safety. Utilizing safety-boundary constraints and dual soft-filtering, the strategy regulates control authority to mitigate violations of Rational Driving Constraints by RL policies while preventing abrupt control mutations. Experiments across four representative scenarios show that PERL converges rapidly and consistently outperforms MPC, PPO, and TD3 in safety, comfort, and platoon stability. Specifically, PERL reduces inverse time-to-collision by 20.3% relative to PPO and improves ride comfort by over 60% compared with TD3. Ultimately, the framework attains the lowest cumulative damping ratio, demonstrating superior string stability and robust generalization capability in real dynamic traffic environments.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文将物理增强残差学习与TD3结合用于车辆编队控制，属于RL与物理模型融合的方法，但与用户的生物力学仿真、植入体设计或FEA代理模型无直接关联。
llm.why_not_core: This paper addresses vehicle platoon control with DMPC+TD3 residual learning; it contains no FEA/surrogate modeling, no biomechanics or implant context, and no engineering structural simulation.

summary_zh.motivation: 在复杂交通环境中兼顾编队控制的物理可解释性与非线性补偿能力。
summary_zh.method: 将分布式模型预测控制与TD3残差学习分层结合，并加入残差幅度正则与时空平滑切换策略。
summary_zh.result: 在四类场景中收敛更快，安全性、舒适性与队列稳定性均优于MPC、PPO和TD3。
summary_zh.validation: 基于四类代表性交通场景的仿真对比实验。

summary_en.motivation: Vehicle platoon control requires reconciling physically interpretable safety constraints with the nonlinear compensation capability needed in complex dynamic environments.
summary_en.method: The authors hierarchically couple distributed model predictive control with a TD3-based residual policy, adding residual-magnitude regularization and a spatiotemporal smooth handover fusion strategy.
summary_en.result: Across four representative scenarios the framework converges rapidly and surpasses MPC, PPO, and TD3 in safety, comfort, and string stability.
summary_en.validation: Performance is assessed through simulation experiments on four representative traffic scenarios with comparative baselines.

papers.title: Remote nanomagnetic activation of mechanotransduction: principles, therapeutic applications, and translational challenges.
papers.abstract: Mechanical signaling is increasingly recognized as a therapeutic target and a key element of the stem cell niche in regenerative medicine and disease. Magnetic nanoparticles (MNPs) offer a practical route for delivering such cues because they can be actuated remotely, functionalized with ligands and incorporated into cells, scaffolds, hydrogels or assay platforms. Magnetically driven mechanotransduction provides evidence that MNPs can act not only as carriers, labels or heating agents, but as active interfaces controlling cell signaling and fate.This review places magnetic ion channel activation (MICA) within magnetic nanomedicine, including magnetic resonance imaging, targeted drug delivery, hyperthermia and magnetic biomaterials. Magneto-mechanical stimulation adds design variables including force, torque, surface functionalisation, target access and particle behavior at the biointerface. Particular attention is given to mechanosensitive targets, including TREK1, TRPV4, PIEZO1, integrins and Frizzled/Wnt signaling. Applications are graded by preclinical maturity: bone repair is best developed, followed by peripheral nerve, cartilage, immune and biofabrication work. A central theme is the evidence pipeline connecting acute cell-level signaling with tissue-level outcomes. Translational barriers include particle quality control, aggregation and protein-corona effects, internalization, field dosimetry, degradation, specificity and uneven reporting. A healthcare future will depend on standardized benchmark models, biogenic MNPs and long-term in vivo outcome data.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该综述讨论磁纳米颗粒远程激活机械转导，仅在生物制造(biofabrication)应用中略有涉及，与AI驱动的生物打印工作流无直接关联。
llm.why_not_core: This is a review of magnetic nanoparticle mechanotransduction with no AI/ML component, no bioprinting workflow integration, and no computational model or autonomous decision-making.

summary_zh.motivation: 机械信号被视为再生医学与疾病治疗的重要靶点，需远程可控的力学刺激手段。
summary_zh.method: 综述磁离子通道激活(MICA)及相关磁纳米颗粒在机械转导中的应用与设计变量。
summary_zh.result: 骨修复最成熟，外周神经、软骨、免疫及生物制造依次跟进，但标准化与体内数据不足。
summary_zh.validation: 文献综述，按临床前成熟度分级评估证据链。

summary_en.motivation: Mechanical signaling is increasingly viewed as a therapeutic target and a stem cell niche component, motivating remotely actuatable mechanical cues.
summary_en.method: The review situates magnetic ion channel activation within magnetic nanomedicine and surveys magneto-mechanical design variables and mechanosensitive targets.
summary_en.result: Applications are graded by preclinical maturity, with bone repair most advanced and biofabrication least developed, while standardization and long-term in vivo data remain lacking.
summary_en.validation: Narrative literature review with evidence graded by preclinical maturity.
